rounds.text: Adcon Capital Services Ltd is currently trading at a significant discount to its intrinsic value, with a price-to-book ratio of just 0.32x [E1]. Furthermore, the company is managing its capital more efficiently than its peers, with an ROA of -3.5% and an ROE of -6.89% significantly outperforming the sector benchmarks of -104.7% and -11.8% respectively [E7, E8]. While the share price has declined, the consistent acceleration in sales growth provides a strong foundation for a potential re-rating as the company scales [E13, E14, E15, E16].
